categories.main_business_segments: Guizhou Zhenhua New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of lithium-ion and sodium-ion battery cathode materials, solid electrolytes, and modified ternary materials. Its products serve new energy vehicles, electric two- and three-wheelers, energy storage, and low-altitude economy sectors. The company also develops electronic new materials and provides technical consulting and import-export services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced cathode material technologies including large single-crystal ternary materials with varying nickel content (medium, high, ultra-high), solid-state electrolyte materials with nano-scale particle size and high ionic conductivity, and sodium-ion battery cathode materials with improved structure for enhanced capacity and stability. Production methods include order-based manufacturing with some stockpiling based on customer forecasts, and continuous R&D in doping, surface modification, and composite solid electrolytes. It also emphasizes digital intelligent manufacturing and resource recycling technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic battery manufacturers supplying power batteries for new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, and energy storage systems. The company has established long-term partnerships with major battery enterprises such as CATL, Lishen Power, and Ganfeng Lithium. End markets include electric vehicles (passenger cars, two- and three-wheelers), energy storage, UPS power supplies, and emerging sectors like low-altitude economy applications (drones, eVTOLs).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guiyang and Qianxinan (Yilong). Its sales are mainly domestic, serving Chinese battery manufacturers, with minimal direct exports. The company is controlled by China Electronics Information Industry Group and its subsidiaries, which have broader geographic footprints.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guizhou Zhenhua New Materials operates mainly in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on cathode material production and development. It also engages in upstream activities such as raw material recycling through its associate company Red Star Electronics, which recovers cobalt, nickel, manganese, and lithium from battery waste.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-nickel ternary cathode materials, sodium-ion battery cathode materials, solid-state electrolytes, and modified ternary materials to improve energy density, safety, and cycle life. It actively develops 6-series ternary materials with superior safety and performance, and solid-state battery key materials. The company invests in diversified product matrices targeting emerging applications like extended-range batteries, semi-solid/solid-state batteries, and low-altitude economy. R&D expenditure increased significantly in 2024, supporting innovation and cost reduction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of cathode materials and related products to battery manufacturers under long-term supply agreements. The company follows a cost-plus pricing model based on raw material costs plus processing fees. It also receives government subsidies related to R&D and industrial development, which are recognized as other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks 9th in China's ternary cathode material production and 5th in single-crystal ternary materials nationally. It holds approximately 60% market share in the 8-series single-crystal ternary material segment. Competitors include other domestic and international cathode material producers focusing on high-nickel and solid-state battery materials. The company leverages its technological advancements and customer ecosystem to maintain a competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company experienced a significant revenue decline of 71.48% to approximately RMB 1.96 billion due to weak demand for ternary materials and delayed large-scale orders for 6-series materials. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 527.7 million, a sharp decline from prior years. Total assets decreased by 18.86% to RMB 7.81 billion. Despite short-term setbacks, the company continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion, aiming for recovery and growth in emerging battery markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its diversified product portfolio covering full-series large single-crystal ternary cathode materials with high nickel content, advanced solid-state electrolyte materials, and innovative sodium-ion battery cathode materials. Its products offer superior cycle life, safety, and energy density, meeting stringent industry standards including safety norms for lithium-ion batteries. The company’s integrated digital manufacturing and resource recycling capabilities further enhance cost efficiency and sustainability, providing customers with reliable, high-performance materials tailored for next-generation energy storage applications.
